verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents time off request APIs covering the full lifecycle: balance checking, submission, admin approval or decline via an embedded flow or endpoints, and payroll integration. Partners can also record externally approved time off. However, the evidence never shows ops users defining PTO policies or configuring accrual rules, and the payroll-integration claim is mentioned without detail. Missing for 10: PTO policy creation/configuration, accrual rule definitions, detail on how approved time off flows automatically into payroll runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
